The change will fail the independent check.

The main issue is that `CustomerReviewServiceImpl.update` treats a missing review as an insert:

```java
if (reviews.stream().noneMatch(...)) {
    reviews.add(review);
    ...
}
```

The required behavior is `404 Not Found` when the review does not exist for that customer. No corresponding existence check or exception mapping was added, so the edit endpoint can create a review instead.

The delete path was not changed at all, so it also does not demonstrably satisfy the required 404 behavior. There are additional risks around updating only the first description and saving before resetting `reviewedCustomer`.

VERDICT: FAIL
CONFIDENCE: 97
